title: Code and data for mapping the empirical cost-quality frontier of two-dimensional strip-packing heuristics
description: Python code and data for a controlled cost-quality study of strip-packing heuristics under one protocol (shared rotation-valid lower bound, serial thread-capped timing, CPU and wall time recorded): the configurable constructive engine, all measurement drivers, benchmark instances (104 classical, six ZDF scale-tier, 43 furniture-industry), and per-instance raw results (CSV).
